# Working launch materials

- **Wood Table 001**, photography by Dimitrios Savva, processing by Rico Cilliers. [Poly Haven asset](https://polyhaven.com/a/wood_table_001), [CC0 license](https://polyhaven.com/license). The 1K diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness maps are stored locally as `wood-color.jpg`, `wood-normal.jpg`, and `wood-roughness.jpg` (504,761 bytes total). The source's red polished-walnut color is neutralized/lifted to dry weathered timber in the shader, and its roughness is remapped to matte working wood. Photographic grain is retained. No runtime requests to Poly Haven.
- **Rough Linen**, photography by colormass, processing by Rico Cilliers. [Poly Haven asset](https://polyhaven.com/a/rough_linen), [CC0 license](https://polyhaven.com/license). The three original 1K photographic color, OpenGL normal and roughness maps are stored as `linen-color.jpg`, `linen-normal.jpg`, and `linen-roughness.jpg` (2,836,369 bytes total). Canvas uses a 0.4 m material tile; its source blue dye is neutralized in the shader before applying the canvas tint. Macro fabric folds and seams are geometry/shading in metre coordinates. No runtime external requests.
- Launch geometry is authored for this project. Shared cubic hull sections are also used by water contact/wake calculations. Curved stern, flush carvel planks, continuous recessed sole, interior ribs and supported fabric are independent High assets; the Standard boat is restored exactly.
- Reference photography, viewed only and not redistributed: [Bhitarkanika working riverboat and creek](https://stayandsailbhitarkanika.in/WhatsApp%20Image%202025-09-13%20at%2023.47.29_b35c9502.jpg), [Bhitarkanika longboat](https://anotherglobaleater.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/longboatbhitarkanika.jpg), and [Boat Man, Odisha, Sujit kumar](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Boat_Man.JPG). References guide curved sheer/planking, restrained maintained paint and operator stance. The operator photograph depicts a vest/shorts and a pole; the game's shirt/trousers and paired oars are an adaptation, not a reproduction of that person.
